title: VideoSpec
description: Video Studio spec: one vertical short video (template, theme, voice, scenes, post copy). Omitted theme/voice/music/captions fields fall back to the template defaults.

look.description: Illustrated-kit look; defaults to the template's own look

look3d.description: 3D look (3D templates only); defaults to the template's own look

captionStyle.description: Caption style; captions.style wins when both are set

provider.description: "library" (default: curated CC0/CC BY tracks by mood), "elevenlabs" (generated per video, opt-in, spends credits; falls back to the library), "none" (no music)

mood.description: Library mood, or "auto" (picked from tone, topic keywords and template)

file.description: Local audio file (absolute or relative to the spec); wins over track/mood

volume.description: Music bed level: 0.12 = 13 dB under the voice; each doubling +6 dB (0.24 = -7 dB, 0.06 = -19 dB)

duck.description: Dip the music a further 9 dB while words are spoken (smooth attack/release)

prompt.description: ElevenLabs Music prompt (provider "elevenlabs" only); default derived from mood + tone

tone.description: Tone hint used by mood auto-pick and the ElevenLabs prompt

volume.description: 1 = SFX peaks 12 dB under the voice; 0.5 = -18 dB, 2 = -6 dB

transition.description: Default entrance: "corte"/"cut", "suave"/"soft" or "semitono"/"halftone" (default by style family)

cover.description: Cover (portada); English keys label/lines/icon/images/sticker/dark also work

lineas.description: Title lines (<=12 chars reads best); *word* in the accent color

avatar.description: Local image path for the footer avatar

style.description: Caption style; overrides theme.captionStyle when set

size.description: Size preset: s, m (default, the classic size), l, xl

position.description: Position preset inside the safe area (x 90-990): top y230-480, upper y420-700, center y820-1100, lower y1130-1390, bottom y1250-1400. Omitted: the template's own band

accent.description: Legacy alias of colors.highlight (colors.highlight wins when both are set)

colors.description: Custom caption colors. Omit to follow the palette automatically (readable contrast is enforced on derived colors); set only the fields the user asked for

highlight.description: Active-word / keyword color; omitted: captions.accent, else theme.palette.accent

box.description: Word box / panel color (boxed, chips, pills, typewriter, dialog, pixel); omitted: derived from the palette

outline.description: Stroke and shadow color (hormozi, punch, karaoke...); omitted: the darkest theme.palette.bg stop

uppercase.description: Force uppercase on (true) or off (false); omitted: the style's own casing

speaker.description: Speaker name shown in the "dialog" style box

src.description: Local file path (absolute or relative to the spec) or https URL

at.description: When the shot starts (default: evenly spaced over the scene)

focus.description: Object id the shot aims at

stock.description: true = this scene uses catalog content on purpose (stock kinds, models, sets) instead of agent-built custom parts / world

type.description: Scene type: headline (titular), chat (chat), editor (editor), phone (movil), counter (contador), stats (cifras), card (ficha), list (lista), steps (pasos), compare (comparacion), strike (tachado), objection (objecion), quiz (pregunta), bars (barras), image (imagen), gallery (galeria), drawing (dibujo), cta (cta)

tipo.description: The pack's Spanish scene type name (alternative to type)

en.description: Moments, in order: "word", "word#2", "word+6", "word-4", "inicio", "fin" or a frame number

sinSubtitulos.description: No subtitles for this sentence (the text is already on screen)

voz.description: How the voice should pronounce the sentence (TTS only)

floor.description: Where characters and props stand, 0..1 of the view height (default 0.59)

depth.description: Parallax plane: far (blurred, slow), mid, subject (crisp), near (dark, blurred foreground)

seed.description: Changes the generated shapes; every video should use new seeds

color2.description: Highlight / second color (snow caps, lit windows, wave crests, tile B)

y.description: Baseline (or top for ground/tiles/grid/rect) as 0..1 of the view height

height.description: Max height as 0..1 of the view height

r.description: circle radius as 0..1 of the view width

lit.description: Amount of glowing details (windows, crystals, grid glow)

speed.description: Drift in pixels per second (clouds, waves, grid scroll)

sprite.description: sprite layer: id of a sprite

count.description: sprite layer: copies spread across the view

glow.description: Emissive: also drawn on the bloom pass

ring.description: circle: draw a ring instead of a disc

at.description: Start (seconds or a word moment; default 0)

amount.description: Size of the move in pixels (pulse: scale delta; walk-across: negative walks right to left)

loop.description: Repeat a one-shot preset (jump, shake, pop-in...)

x.description: Horizontal position, 0..1 of the view

y.description: Vertical position, 0..1 of the view (the element's anchor)

opacity.description: Dithered, so it stays pixel art

frame.description: Sprite frame (held until the next key)

ease.description: Easing of the segment arriving at this key
